basis.text: The description does not give whether the space is for fewer than 50 people, so the proposed occupancy group is not established.

rules_conditional_unsupplied.overall_line: A Conditional Use Authorization is needed if the business is part of a chain with eleven or more other locations (formula retail). Of the 4 approvals this concept needs: 1 further review (building permit and change of use), 2 insufficient information (zoning and use, alcohol licence), 1 allowed (health permit).
